config.sampling_policy: Complete original10888.888889-second recipe and fixed10-mm source1-X probe; no shortening or search. Nested spatial nodes, full represented disk plus a fully covered135-mm interior ROI. Source geometry/exponents/models remain fixed; only existing odd sampling_order changes.
config.plateau_policy: Report nonmonotone changes and aggregate/map distinctions. Do not blindly extend grid/source ladders or claim physical accuracy.
